name: Worshipers of Isilu
description: Followers who wear moon-motif armor, hold vigils over their dead and seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor.

relations.note: They worship Isilu and rally behind its symbols.
relations.quote: The worshipers of Isilu lay claim to all Lorwyn-Shadowmoor and seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor.

relations.note: Each side seeks to convert the whole plane to its own aspect.
relations.quote: seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor
